la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s06: Irene looks at the face. It is the photo. It is the stop. Maybe is not maybe any more.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s07: The woman speaks first. A low voice, in daylight.

la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s09: Irene does not smile. Her heart goes fast. She has anger, and fear, together.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s12: Irene breathes. She wanted a name. Now she has it, and it is not easier.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s13: You frightened me. The lights, the pause, the sheet in the grate.

la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s19: In the corridor there is no light. I use the rooms. I had the old timetable in my head.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s20: Then I saw you, at the window. I stopped. Then I answered.

la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s22: Irene listens. She does not forgive, not yet. She understands the facts, one under the other.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s23: On Friday Alme destroys. The class registers, the copies, the lists.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s24: If you help me, you don’t go in. You don’t take the key. You lose time, at work.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s25: A box. You put it where it isn’t. One day, two. That’s enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s26: It is not a film theft. It is time. Friday is in two days.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s27: Irene looks at the bag. She looks at Sara. She looks at the closed gym.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s28: Loredana cried. Quinto offered a key. Alme smiles.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s29: Now a woman says: lose a box. Irene is no longer only someone who counts windows.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s30: I should say no. I should call Piva. I should go to work and scan.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s32: Sara does not insist. She does not touch Irene. She nods, or almost.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s33: Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday. Then Friday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s34: Irene leaves this way, toward the street. She does not go in. She does not say yes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s35: She writes later, in the attic: Sara is the light. She asks for time, not the school. I: I don’t know.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s36: She does not write: I understood everything. She has not understood everything. She has a face, and a request.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s37: Behind the gym there was concrete, and a bag, and two days.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s38: Irene goes to the town hall the same Wednesday, afterwards. She scans. She does not lose a box. Not today.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s39: Alme says little. Friday, she repeats. Irene says: all right. She does not mention Sara.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s40: In the evening she does not turn the lamp toward the school. She knows who it is. She does not need the grid, tonight.

la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s43: Irene, at the town hall, touches a box of registers and leaves it. Not today. Wednesday is not the basement day.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s44: If you help me, Sara said. If. Irene keeps the if until Thursday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s45: Not everything is solved. It is a meeting. A face. A request for time. An I don’t know.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s46: Behind the gym there is little wind. Sara holds the bag as she holds the registers: close.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s47: Irene asks again: the old hours. Sara says: room two, then three, then eight, as before.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s48: Then you. Then the pause. Then the three slow. Then the two. Then the sheet.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s49: It is not magic. It is a woman without a corridor, with a camping lamp, and a date: Friday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s50: Irene goes back to the attic Wednesday evening. She does not knock at Loredana’s. She does not call Piva. She does not say yes to Sara.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s51: Tomorrow is Thursday. Tomorrow she can lose a box, or not. Tonight she only keeps: I don’t know.
la-casa-delle-finestre-17:s52: Wednesday is over. She has not said yes. She has not said no. She has a name, and two days. That’s enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s01: Today is Thursday. Yesterday she saw Sara. Tomorrow is Friday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s02: Irene is downstairs, with the boxes. The scanner is on. Alme is upstairs.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s03: First she does the real work. Pages, stamps, numbers on the town-hall sheet.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s04: She scans one folder. Then another. Then another again.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s05: The hours pass. She is a little hungry. She is sweating, yes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s06: Morning: lists. Then copies. Then a coffee, standing, without Alme.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s07: At noon she has scanned enough to look normal. The basement waits.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s08: I should not have, she thinks. But yesterday she said: I don’t know. Today her hands choose.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s09: There is a box of registers, copies, lists. It is not the closed folder. It is an ordinary box.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s10: Irene takes it. She does not put it on the scanner. She carries it further down, into the basement.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s11: There are other boxes there, old, with dust. She puts this one behind, where you do not see it at once.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s12: I made a mistake, she will say, if someone asks. But she knows: it is not a mistake. It is a choice.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s13: Her hands shake. She shuts the basement door. She goes up. The scanner waits.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s14: She works more. She scans what remains, the small folders, the short lists.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s15: I did it, she thinks. I should not have. But Friday is tomorrow, and Sara asked for time.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s16: She is not a hero. She hid a box. That is all, and it is heavy.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s17: Alme comes down in the afternoon, with a pen and a sheet of numbers.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s18: She counts the boxes. One, two, three. Then again. Then she looks at the empty space.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s20: Irene holds the scanner. She does not look at the basement.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s21: Maybe a mistake. I counted them this morning.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s22: Alme does not raise her voice. She counts again. The space remains.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s23: She looks at Irene too long. She does not say where. She does not say: come to me.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s24: Then she goes up, with the sheet. She does not smile, this time.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s25: Irene stays downstairs. She did it. She should not have. But the box is elsewhere, for a day.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s26: The basement is a little dark. She shut the door. The old boxes cover the new one.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s27: It is not a big plan. It is a day. Tomorrow the machine wants everything.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s28: Irene washes her hands, downstairs, too long. The sweat stays.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s29: Alme does not come back. The afternoon ends. Irene goes up, signs the hours sheet, leaves.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s30: In the street she knows she has changed the work, not only the notebook. She did it. She should not have.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s31: She spends the hours after work without telling Sara: I did it. She does not look for her Thursday evening.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s32: The box is in the basement. Alme counted. The look was too long. This is the cost, today.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s33: Tomorrow is Friday. Irene knows where the box is. She also knows Alme knows something is missing.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s34: In the basement she counted the steps. Ten, maybe. She put the box behind two older ones.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s35: She closed it. She went up. She scanned more, to look the same as yesterday, as Wednesday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s36: Alme said: one is missing. Irene said: maybe a mistake. It was a lie, the second one.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s37: The first was no, anything odd. This is heavier. She should not have. But she did it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s38: Thursday ends like this: a box elsewhere, a look too long, and Irene who leaves without coffee.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s39: She worked from nine to four, almost. Then ten minutes down, in the basement. Then the scanner again.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s40: Nobody saw her carry the box. Or Alme saw her, and did not say. Irene does not know.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s41: It is not a heist. It is a wanted mistake, in a small town hall, a Thursday before the machine.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s42: Irene walks home with her hands in her pockets. There is no USB stick, not yet. There is only the sweat.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s43: Thursday is not Friday. The machine has not taken that box. One day of time, dirty, real.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s44: I did it, I should not have, but: three pieces. Irene keeps all of them, without losing the but.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s45: The basement stays shut. The stairs stay. The scanner stays. She leaves, and the town hall stays with a hole.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s46: Alme has not called. Not yet. Thursday evening is this silence, heavier than the coffee.
la-casa-delle-finestre-18:s47: Irene goes toward the school, not toward home. She needs air. She will find Quinto, or not. It is still Thursday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s01: It is still Thursday, after work. Irene does not go home at once.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s02: She walks toward the school. She needs air, not a key.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s03: Quinto is there, near the gate, without the can. The keys are there, in his pocket.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s04: Miss. Today you did something, at the town hall.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s05: Irene stops on this side. She does not lie well. She does not explain the box.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s07: Quinto nods. He does not offer the key, this time.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s08: I knew about the cracks. Before the closure. I saw them, upstairs.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s09: Irene listens. It is not a long speech. It is a fact, late.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s10: I cannot talk to the Carabinieri. I say nothing to the marshal.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s11: I do not stop Sara. She goes in, in her way. I do not stop her.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s12: Irene looks at the gate. The chain is still there, for now.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s14: Because you look. Because I water dead plants, and you count windows.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s15: Irene does not laugh. She saw the dead plants on the second day. Now she understands the sentence.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s16: He does not go up, he says. He does not speak. He does not stop Sara. Three nos, like hers, and different.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s17: Quinto does not ask forgiveness. He does not say: I was good. He says little.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s18: I water dead plants so I don’t go up.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s19: Then he walks away, toward the courtyard, with the keys.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s20: Irene stays on this side. She does not go in. It is not her door.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s21: Later, going home, she goes past again. She looks at the gate.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s22: The chain is not there. The gate is shut, but without a chain. Once.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s23: It is not for her. She knows that. It is for Sara, if Sara goes in, in her way.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s24: Irene does not try the gate. She does not take the opening as an invitation.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s25: She writes: Quinto knew. He does not speak. He does not stop Sara. Gate without a chain, once, not for me.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s26: Tomorrow is Friday. Today stays Thursday, still, until night.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s27: Quinto is not the light. Irene knew that. Now she also knows: he saw the cracks, and he stayed silent.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s28: It is not courage. It is not an enemy. It is a man with a can, and a chain taken off once.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s29: Irene does not use the gate. She goes back to the attic. She does not look at the grid to count. She knows who moves over there.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s30: Tomorrow the machine. Tomorrow Alme. Tonight only this: Quinto changes, a little, and does not talk to Piva.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s31: It is not a redemption. He does not die. He does not become good in three sentences.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s32: He takes a chain off once, for Sara. Irene sees, and does not go in. This is the chapter, not more.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s33: Quinto speaks little, as always. He does not make a salvation speech. He says: I knew. I cannot. I do not stop.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s34: Irene asks about the cracks, once. He says: upstairs, the wall. The children, no. Then he is silent.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s35: He does not testify. He does not use that word. He says: I don’t talk to the Carabinieri.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s36: The chain on the ground, or gone: Irene does not look for it. She only sees the gate without iron around it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s37: Thursday night. Tomorrow Friday. Quinto remains the caretaker. He is not the lamp. He is not a hero.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s38: Irene repeats his words, in her head: I knew, I cannot, I do not say, I do not stop Sara.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s39: I water dead plants so I don’t go up: this remains. It is the truest sentence of the evening.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s40: The gate without a chain is not for the archivist. It is once, for the teacher, if she goes in.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s41: Irene goes up to the attic. She does not try keys she does not have. Tomorrow is Friday, not an exploration.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s42: She does not go in. It is not her gate. Quinto said it without saying it: for Sara, not for me.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s43: Irene accepts the no at the entrance. She already has a dirty yes, at the town hall, in the hidden box.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s44: Two different yeses: one is a lost box. One would be going in. She has done the first, not the second.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s45: Quinto leaves. Irene leaves. The school stays, with the gate a little more open, not for her.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s46: She is not Quinto. She does not water. She has no keys. She has a lost box, and a Friday ahead.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s47: She writes the chain. She writes: not for me. She closes it. Tomorrow is Friday, not Thursday. The night is still Thursday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-19:s48: It is not another day. It is the same Thursday, late. Then, only after, Friday. That is all, tonight.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s01: Today is Friday. It is not Tuesday. It is not Wednesday. It is not Thursday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s02: At the town hall the machine for destroying is on. It makes noise. It smells of hot paper.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s03: Alme is in the office early. She says: today. There is no time. Little is left.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s04: An hour is left, she says later, or two. Irene does not look at the clock. She looks at the boxes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s05: Now, too much paper. Now, the machine. Now, or never.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s06: Irene carries up the boxes that remain. One after another. Not the basement one, not yet.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s07: Now it is late to call Piva, she thinks. Now it is late to say I don’t know.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s08: She has a small USB stick in her pocket. She bought it last night, after Quinto.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s09: It is not the internet. It is not a film. It is a copy, if she manages.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s10: When Alme is on the phone, Irene is alone a minute, downstairs.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s11: She opens the town-hall computer, the scanner one. She puts in the stick.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s12: She copies the folders already scanned. She copies fast, not everything, enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s13: Her heart goes. An hour is left, or less, before the machine takes the rest.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s14: She takes out the stick. She puts it in her pocket. She closes the screen.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s15: Then she goes up with an ordinary box, for the machine. She does the visible work.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s16: Alme points. Irene puts the papers in the machine. Too late to stop. The noise continues.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s17: The basement box stays downstairs. For now. Irene does not carry it up.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s18: In the corridor, afterwards, Irene goes toward the stairs, with her hand in her pocket.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s19: Alme is there. She does not shout. She does not run. She is only in the corridor, opposite.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s20: She looks at Irene’s pocket, or it seems so. Then she looks at her eyes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s22: It is not a shout. It is a sentence, quietly, like the coffee of other days, and it is not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s23: Irene does not run away. She does not throw the stick. She walks behind Alme, toward the office.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s24: Today is Friday. The machine is working. The copy is in her pocket. Alme said: come with me.

la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s26: The stick weighs little. The papers in the machine do not come back. Little is left, and too much, together.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s27: She does not upload anything to the internet. She does not run. She follows Alme. Friday is now.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s28: In the corridor the noise of the machine still arrives. Too late for the papers already inside.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s29: Irene holds the stick. Alme holds the door. Two women. No race. One sentence: come with me.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s30: In the morning she carried boxes up. At noon the machine was already eating. In the afternoon little is left.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s31: She copied when Alme was on the phone. One minute. Folders already in the scanner, not the basement.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s32: The stick is a copy. The live papers go into the machine. Two destinies, Friday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s33: In the corridor Alme does not shout. She says come with me, and Irene goes, because running away is another film.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s34: Alme’s choice is not here yet. There is Friday, the machine, the pocket, and a door.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s35: At nine: boxes. At eleven: noise. At one: the stick. At three: the corridor. Now: the office.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s36: Too late for Tuesday. Too late for I don’t know. Friday asks for a copy, and a door closed after.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s37: Irene does not know if Alme saw the stick. She knows Alme saw her, in the corridor.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s38: Come with me. Irene goes. The machine continues. The story is not finished in the street.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s39: Nine, eleven, one, three: Friday has hours, not weeks. Little is left. Now it is the office.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s40: Irene does not throw the stick in the corridor. She keeps it. She goes in. Alme shuts the door, quietly.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s41: Outside, the machine still works. Inside, two chairs, an office, Friday afternoon.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s42: Irene waits for Alme to speak. She does not speak yet. This is the last fact of the chapter: the door is closed, the choice is not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s43: Friday morning, Friday noon, Friday afternoon: three pieces of the same day, not three new days.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s44: The copy is in her pocket. The papers are in the machine. Alme is opposite. An hour is left, or it is already late.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s45: Irene sits. She does not explain yet. She waits. This is Friday, all the way through. It is not Saturday. It is not another Tuesday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s46: Alme stays standing. Irene stays seated. Between them the table. In the pocket the stick. Outside the noise.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s47: Nobody runs. Nobody shouts. Friday asks only this, for now: two women, a door, and nothing said yet.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s48: Now. Too late. Little left. Three ways of saying the same Friday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-20:s49: Behind the door is the office. There is not yet Alme’s choice. There is only: come with me.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s01: The door is shut. Today is still Friday. Outside the machine makes noise.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s02: Alme stays standing. Irene stays seated. Between them the table.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s03: Alme does not shout. She does not make a long speech. She speaks in pieces.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s04: We closed the school because the children could not stay.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s05: The wall was not safe. This is true.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s06: Irene listens. She does not say: and Sara’s cracks. She does not play the lawyer.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s07: So we closed. So the town says: it is empty.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s08: But I also protected my job. And the town’s story.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s09: It is not the whole truth. It is enough to shut a door, two years ago.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s10: Irene keeps her hand in her pocket, on the stick. Alme looks at the pocket, then not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s11: She does not ask about the copy. She does not ask about Sara. She asks about the box.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s12: The one in the basement. I know.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s13: Irene does not lie again. She does not speak. She nods, almost.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s14: On paper, that box is already destroyed. Today. Friday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s15: It is not courage. It is not clean pity. It is a small thing, and cowardly, and useful.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s16: Irene understands: one box remains. Not a trial. Not television.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s17: Alme sits, at last. Her hands on the table, still.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s18: I will not confess in the square. I will not do it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s19: The noise of the machine continues. Friday does not stop for two women.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s20: Irene should say thank you, or no, or everything. She says little.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s21: The box stays downstairs. I do not help twice.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s22: Now you go to Marshal Piva, or you don’t. This is your choice.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s23: It is not an order. It is a door, open, after a shut door.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s24: Irene stands. The stick stays in her pocket. Alme does not take it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s25: The mystery is not finished in one room. It is a box, and a choice, and Friday that continues.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s26: Irene leaves. Alme does not say goodbye. She only says, quietly: Piva, or not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s27: In the corridor the noise is the same. Friday did not become another day inside the office.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s28: Irene does not have a full confession. She has pieces: children, a job, a box already destroyed on paper.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s29: It is not courage, Alme said. Irene believes it. She does not love her for this. She does not hate her like a film.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s30: The stick is heavy. The box remains. Piva is a choice, not a prize.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s31: She goes down the stairs. She does not go back to the basement. She must not, today. Alme said: it stays downstairs.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s32: Outside it is still afternoon. The machine works. Irene walks toward the Carabinieri, or she thinks about it. Then she walks.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s33: Not everything is explained. Sara is missing, the town is missing, what Piva will do is missing. This chapter is Alme, and a no to courage.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s34: Alme spoke of the children, and of the job, and of the town’s story. Three reasons, not only one. Irene keeps them apart.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s35: If she tells Piva everything, Alme does not help twice. If she does not tell, the box still remains, on paper, destroyed.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s36: So the choice is hers, and dirty, like the box. It is not an exam with only one answer.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s37: Irene does not ask why Alme waited for Friday. She does not ask about registers from ten years ago. That is not this chapter.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s38: She walks. The town hall stays behind, with the machine on. Ahead is Piva, or the attic. She chooses the Carabinieri’s road.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s39: She does not go back to Alme for another sentence. Once is enough. It is not courage, and she does not ask for it again.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s40: The director stays in the office. Irene is already in the afternoon, toward a small room, with formal lei.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s41: Friday continues. The box, on paper, is destroyed. On the ground, downstairs, it is there. This Irene takes to Piva, or not: she takes it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s42: She has not understood Alme in five minutes. She has understood enough: children yes, job yes, confession in the square no.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s43: Two women, a table, a machine outside. Then Irene alone, in the street, with a choice Alme will not make for her.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s44: It is not a villain’s monologue. Alme said little, and left a box, and spoke of Piva. End of the room.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s45: Irene does not know if this is pity. She knows it is not courage. She knows Friday does not wait. She walks.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s46: They do not arrest Alme in this room. There is no national scandal. There is a director, and a box, and a no said twice.
la-casa-delle-finestre-21:s47: Irene leaves the town hall. Friday afternoon. The choice is Piva. This is the chapter. The rest is not here.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s01: Friday evening Irene goes to the Carabinieri. It is not Tuesday. It is late, and she knows it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s02: Marshal Piva receives her in a small room. Lei, formal.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s03: Sit down. Tell me what you have seen.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s04: Irene does not play detective. She tells the facts, in order, like an archive.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s05: I saw a light in the closed school. Then a timetable. Then a pause. Then a sheet: no Carabinieri, registers.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s06: On Friday the town hall destroys papers. I hid a box. Then I made a copy.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s07: Sara Neri was the light. Alme knows about the box. Quinto knew about the cracks.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s08: Piva writes. He does not smile. He does not say: well done. He does not say: you solved it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s09: You should have come earlier. The sheet said not to call. But you should have come earlier.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s10: Yes. I know. I am late.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s11: Piva does not open a trial in two minutes. He says the school stays closed.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s12: It is not a story for television. It is a town. It is local.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s13: We will check the papers. You have told the truth. That is enough, for tonight.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s14: Irene leaves a copy of the facts; she sells nothing. She goes out. It is not a party.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s15: Near the school, in the evening, there is Sara. The bag is there. The anger is there.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s17: Yes. Late. After Alme. After the machine.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s18: Sara speaks fast, with anger. Then she stops. She breathes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s19: The registers. One box. Not everything. But not everything is dead.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s20: Irene does not ask for thank you. Sara does not give it at once. Then, quietly: all right. Almost.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s21: The school stays closed. Nobody goes in to celebrate. Two women in the street, Friday evening.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s22: Piva, earlier, said one thing, at the door.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s23: The windows were never the crime. The paper was.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s24: Irene keeps that sentence. She does not put it in the notebook as a triumph.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s25: Sara goes toward the gym, without a lamp. Irene goes toward home.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s26: It is not the end of the school. It is the end of this evening. Local. Late. True enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s27: Piva did not say: you are smarter than us. He wrote. He said: local. He said: late.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s28: Irene does not take a victory home. She takes a simple report: I told the truth, late.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s29: Sara has gone without a lamp. This is a new, small fact. It is not a happy ending.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s30: The school stays closed. The children do not come back on Monday. Irene knew. Piva said it without emphasis.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s31: Friday is long. Morning the machine, afternoon Alme, evening Piva, then Sara. One day, three rooms, no triumph.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s32: Irene goes up toward the attic. She does not run. She does not call the papers. The town stays the town.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s33: She told Piva the facts, not the theories. Light, timetable, pause, sheet, box, copy, Sara, Alme, Quinto. Then she was silent.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s34: Piva will check. She is not the law. This is heavy, and also not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s35: Sara had anger because the sheet said no. Then she saw that one box is not dead. Almost all right.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s36: Nobody shoots. Nobody wins in the square. Friday evening ends like this: local, late, with the windows still shut.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s37: In the Carabinieri room there was a table, a chair, a man who writes. That is enough. Not a court.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s38: Irene used lei, as one should. Piva used lei. Nobody became a friend in twenty minutes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s39: After Sara, the street is empty of celebration. There is only the dark that arrives, and an attic that waits.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s40: She told the truth late. Piva heard it. Sara heard it. The town, no, not all of it, not tonight.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s41: The windows were not the crime: Irene repeats Piva’s sentence, without making it a slogan.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s42: There is no verdict tonight. There is a report, local, late. There is Sara almost relieved. There is the school closed, like yesterday.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s43: Irene does not celebrate. She goes up the stairs of the house. Friday was long. This is enough for a chapter of law, not of heroes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s44: Piva stays at the station. Sara stays in town, maybe. Irene stays with the delay, and with the paper, and with the windows that were not the crime.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s45: She spoke late. She knows. Piva knows. Sara knows. There is no gunshot. There is a room, and facts, and away.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s46: Local. Late. The paper, not the windows. Irene keeps three things, and goes to bed without a party.
la-casa-delle-finestre-22:s47: She is not smarter than the law. She is late, and she has spoken. This is her place, tonight.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s01: In the evening Irene is in the attic. She has turned off the room light.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s02: She looks at the school. The grid is dark. All the windows. Also three, opposite.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s03: There is no lamp. There is no pause. There is no timetable.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s04: It looks empty. It looked empty before too. Now it is, at night, in another way.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s05: Irene waits for nine, out of habit. Then nine ten. Nothing.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s06: She still looks. Not because she is a detective. Because her eyes have learned that row.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s07: She opens the notebook on the table. The pages still coincide, underneath. The numbers are there.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s08: She takes the pen. She does not write a new number. She does not write tonight nothing, as a map fact.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s09: She closes the notebook. She leaves it closed. The habit stops here, by choice.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s10: She has counted enough. She has understood enough. Not everything. Enough to close.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s11: She gets into bed. She does not sleep. The dark of the school enters the room, without light.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s12: She remembers the three slow. She remembers the two. She remembers Sara in daylight, behind the gym.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s13: She remembers Loredana crying over the numbers. She remembers Quinto and the dead plants.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s14: No ghost comes back. No new light. Only the grid, black, like the first day, and different.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s16: Irene is not sure she prefers this.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s17: Before she was afraid of the light. Now she has an honest dark, and she still does not sleep.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s18: She does not open the notebook again. She does not turn the lamp toward the school.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s19: She listens to the stairs. Loredana does not come down. Nobody calls. Friday is still today, or almost.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s20: She stays looking a little. Then she turns toward the wall. Her eyes stay open.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s21: Without light. With the notebook shut. With the school opposite, empty of lamp, not empty of memory.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s22: The first day the light moved. Tonight no. The image has turned, and she has let it turn.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s23: She opens her eyes in the dark of the attic. She counts, without a voice, the windows nobody lights.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s24: Then she stops. That row is no longer her job. It is a house opposite, at night.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s25: She does not want a new mystery. It does not arrive. The silence is only silence, and that is enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s26: She turns again. Window three stays dark. She does not prefer it, not yet. She stays in the middle of sleep.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s27: The notebook is on the table, closed. Tomorrow maybe she leaves. Tonight she stays, without light, on purpose.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s28: She opened the notebook once. She saw the old numbers. She did not add any. She closed it. This is the gesture.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s29: She does not sleep because the body remembers nine. Not because a ghost knocks. The heart goes, then not, then again.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s30: Opposite, dark. She is not sure. Preferring the dark would be easy, and it is not easy.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s31: She stays like this until late. Then, maybe, she sleeps a little, without a map.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s32: She looked at the grid like the first day. This time she did not count in order to write. She counted in order to stop.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s33: The facing window is dark. She does not know if it is better. She knows the notebook is closed. That is enough, for the gesture.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s34: No new monster. No light that returns for a sequel. Only sleep that does not come, and a school without a lamp.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s35: Without light: the title is true. She looks all the same. Then she shuts her eyes, and the grid stays outside.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s36: The notebook does not receive a new line. This is the night’s decision, small and clear.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s37: She is a little afraid of the honest dark. She is also afraid of opening the numbers again. She does not open them. This is the cost, and the cut.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s38: Evening without light. Attic. School opposite. Notebook shut. Sleep that is missing. She is not sure she prefers it. End of the night, almost.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s39: She has stopped numbering. This changes her, more than the grid. The grid is the same. She is not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s40: She does not add a number. She does not open again. She does not prefer it yet. She looks at the dark opposite, and stays. This is the chapter, without new light.
la-casa-delle-finestre-23:s41: She shuts her eyes. Three is dark. She does not count. This is enough. She stays, without new light, and she is not sure.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s01: After a few days Alme calls her into the office. It is not Friday. It is a normal work day.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s02: The contract is short. We are not renewing it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s03: Irene almost knew it. It is not a prize. It is not an arrest. It is an administrative no.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s04: Alme does not smile as at the beginning. She says: you did the work. Then that’s all.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s05: Thank you, Irene says. This town is not mine. I do not sell the story.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s06: Alme nods. She does not help twice. She does not offer another job.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s07: Irene leaves the basement keys, if there were any. She leaves the scanner. She leaves the boxes.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s08: The archive stays at the town hall. She does not.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s09: In the attic she puts clothes in a bag. The notebook stays, closed, at the bottom.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s10: It is not a novel to sell. It is a work notebook. It is not hers to sell.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s11: Loredana is in the kitchen. She offers a coffee. She does not talk about her daughter. She does not talk about the windows.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s12: Have a good trip, she says. Irene says: I’m sorry, again, for the numbers.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s13: Loredana shakes her head. Go. The school is empty, she says, out of habit, and Irene does not correct her.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s14: Empty: a word that has changed meaning, and that the town keeps the same.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s15: Irene goes down to the street, in daylight, with the bag. There is a bus, near the square.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s16: First she looks at the school, a moment. The grid is only a building. Windows, wall, gate.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s17: One window is dark, ordinary. Not a lamp. Not a signal. A window.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s18: She looks up, like someone who knew. Then she looks away. She leaves.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s19: She does not stay. She is not the heroine of San Quirico. She is an archivist with a finished contract.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s20: The bus leaves. The school stays. It looks empty. Someone was there. She is not, any more.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s21: There is no new job as a prize. There is no Alme in handcuffs at the stop.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s22: The light does not return in the grid while the bus turns. Irene does not look for it.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s23: She looks a moment at the town, then at the road. She leaves for real. The archive is not hers.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s24: San Quirico stays with its windows. She stays with a closed notebook, at the bottom of a bag.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s25: It is not a film happy ending. It is a finished contract, and a look up, and then away.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s26: At the town hall she left the archive. In the attic she left the room empty of her, not of the school.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s27: Loredana said empty out of habit. Irene left without correcting the word. It was not the moment for a lesson.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s28: On the bus she does not open the notebook. She looks out. One dark window, ordinary, and that is enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s29: She leaves. Those who must stay, stay. She does not. This is the archive that remains for her: a glance, and a no to selling.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s30: The contract not renewed is not a film punishment. It is a no from the town hall, after short work.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s31: Irene does not ask to stay. It is not hers. She looks at the windows like someone who knew, and then gets on the bus.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s32: End. One dark, ordinary window. The school looks empty. She leaves. Enough.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s33: She does not stay to become the woman of the windows. It is not her archive. It is a town, and a bus, and away.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s34: She looks up one last time, in daylight. Then she does not look any more. She leaves.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s35: The town-hall archive stays there, with Alme, with the boxes, with a machine now still. She takes away only the closed notebook.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s36: She does not sell. She does not stay. She is not a heroine. She looks at the windows, leaves, and the school looks empty. That is all.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s37: After a few days the no to the contract. Then the kitchen. Then the bag. Then the bus. Then the look, and away. No light that returns.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s38: The archive is not hers to sell. The school is not hers to save alone. She looks, leaves. One dark, ordinary window. End.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s39: She leaves San Quirico sul Nera in daylight. There is no prize. There is no arrest. There is a bus, and a look, and a school that looks empty.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s40: The town stays. The grid stays. The word empty stays, changed, the same in Loredana’s mouth. Irene leaves all the same.
la-casa-delle-finestre-24:s41: She does not come back. She does not switch it on. She does not sell. She looks once, and that is enough. Then the engine starts, and she goes away from this small town.
